description: React component implementing a virtualized list with dynamic item measurement and scrolling behavior.

classes.name: DynamicVirtualizedList
classes.description: A React PureComponent that renders a virtualized, scrollable list with dynamic item measurement and scroll management.

methods.name: scrollBy
methods.description: Scrolls the list by a specified offset or amount.

methods.name: scrollTo
methods.description: Scrolls to a specific offset, optionally using animation frame.

methods.name: scrollToItem
methods.description: Scrolls to a specific item index with alignment and offset options.

methods.name: componentDidMount
methods.description: Initializes scroll position after component mounts.

methods.name: getSnapshotBeforeUpdate
methods.description: Captures scroll position before DOM updates for smooth scrolling.

methods.name: componentDidUpdate
methods.description: Handles updates after component re-renders, manages scroll adjustments.

methods.name: componentWillUnmount
methods.description: Cancels any ongoing animation frames on unmount.

methods.name: _callOnItemsRendered
methods.description: Memoized callback to notify items rendered.

methods.name: _callOnScroll
methods.description: Memoized callback to notify scroll events.

methods.name: _callPropsCallbacks
methods.description: Invokes onItemsRendered and onScroll callbacks with current range and scroll info.

methods.name: _commitHook
methods.description: Initial scroll positioning after component mount.

methods.name: _dataChange
methods.description: Handles data changes, triggers load more if needed.

methods.name: _heightChange
methods.description: Adjusts scroll if height change affects bottom position.

methods.name: _widthChange
methods.description: Adjusts scroll if width change affects bottom position.

methods.name: _getItemStyle
methods.description: Caches and returns style for list items based on index.

methods.name: _getRangeToRender
methods.description: Calculates range of items to render based on scroll position and overscan.

methods.name: _correctScroll
methods.description: Corrects scroll position to match stored offset.

methods.name: _generateOffsetMeasurements
methods.description: Calculates and caches item offsets and total size.

methods.name: _handleNewMeasurements
methods.description: Updates measurements and adjusts scroll if item size changes.

methods.name: _onItemRowUnmount
methods.description: Handles cleanup when an item unmounts.

methods.name: _onScrollVertical
methods.description: Handles vertical scroll events, updates state accordingly.

methods.name: _outerRefSetter
methods.description: Sets outer DOM ref and updates width.

methods.name: _renderItems
methods.description: Renders visible list items with styles and wrappers.
